jobs.title: Trainee Project Engineer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Trainee Project Engineer to join our Survey and Robotics team in Westhill. This is an exciting opportunity for someone at the start of their career who is looking for engaging, hands-on experience working on software development, automation tools, AI-driven solutions and workshop improvement projects. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and operational teams to develop technical, problem-solving, and project delivery skills through involvement in the design, build, testing, and deployment of both digital and physical solutions that enhance workshop and business processes.

With a planned start date in January 2027, this is a fantastic opportunity to secure your next role and look ahead to an exciting new challenge.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Supporting the design, development and implementation of innovative tools and systems that improve operational and workshop efficiency.
* Assisting with software development, automation projects and emerging AI-based solutions.
* Identifying opportunities to reduce manual processes and introduce smarter ways of working.
* Working alongside Project Engineers to turn ideas into practical, real-world solutions and helping improve workshop equipment, digital systems and business processes.
* Supporting the testing, troubleshooting and deployment of new technologies and systems.
* Creating and maintaining technical documentation, user guides and operating procedures.
* Collaborating with technical, operational and workshop teams to understand challenges and deliver improvements.

  

**What experience you'll bring:**

* HNC/HND qualification (or currently studying towards one) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages such as Python, C#, JavaScript, VBA or similar.
* An understanding of software applications, databases, networking and operating systems.
* A genuine interest in engineering, automation and emerging technologies, including AI.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a curious mindset with a desire to learn and develop.
* Enthusiasm, initiative and a hands-on approach to tackling challenges.

  

**Who we are:**

Established in 1985, Ashtead Technology is a leading provider of subsea equipment rental solutions, advanced underwater technologies, and support services to the global offshore energy sector. With over 40 years of experience, we specialise in enabling customers to understand the subsea environment and manage offshore energy production infrastructure, including offshore wind farms and oil and gas platforms. Our offering spans the entire lifecycle of these infrastructures, with over 85% of our equipment fungible across both markets.

Headquartered in the UK, Ashtead Technology operates globally with over 600 staff and more than 30,000 assets, making us one of the largest independent rental fleets in the industry. We continue to invest in equipment and have a strong in-house engineering capability to provide the most technologically advanced solutions. Our growth, driven by strategic acquisitions and organic expansion, culminated in a successful IPO in 2021, with shares now trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange.

**What we’ll offer:**

* A dynamic & collaborative team environment where your contributions are valued, and your ideas welcomed.
* A positive and inclusive company culture that fosters collaboration, creativity, and mutual respect among team members.

* Practical, real-world experience allowing you to apply theoretical knowledge gained during your HNC/HND, to actual work solutions
* The opportunity to develop and enhance your skills in the Survey & Robotics field, building a strong foundation for future career growth
* Working closely with professionals who will provide a supportive learning environment where you can ask questions, seek guidance, mentorship and receive feedback.

jobs.title: Senior Back-end Developer
jobs.description:
Build the backend that connects the future of secure access. As a Senior Back-end Developer, you will join our skilled, international team of developers based in Stockholm, dedicated to building next-generation products and access control solutions that enable identity, authentication and access experiences for customers worldwide. Why this role matters At ASSA ABLOY, technology plays a direct role in creating safer, more open environments. Your work will help make sure different product components can communicate and work together reliably — turning individual technologies into complete access solutions.
  
  
This is a role for someone who enjoys more than simply implementing requirements. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, solve challenging backend and integration problems, and continuously improve both the software and the way the team works. The role You’ll join a small and strongly connected team working in a highly self-organised agile environment. The team values close collaboration, open discussion and learning from one another, with approaches such as pair programming and mob programming forming part of how you work together.
  
  
You’ll take ownership of backend development and integrations, from designing solutions through to implementation, testing and continuous improvement. You’ll also contribute to technical discussions and decisions, while having the independence to explore problems and find solutions before bringing others in. What you’ll work on Build and evolve backend services — develop high-quality software using Golang and modern software engineering practices, with a focus on distributed systems and product connectivity. Develop APIs and integrations — create and maintain REST APIs and modern integration patterns that connect different product components.
  
  
Shape technical solutions — contribute to software architecture, object-oriented design and decisions around scalable, maintainable solutions. Strengthen software quality — work with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and code reviews to help deliver reliable software. Solve complex problems — troubleshoot and improve existing solutions while looking for practical ways to make the product and development process better. Work closely with the team — collaborate through pair and mob programming, share knowledge and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
  
  
What will help you succeed 5+ years of backend software development experience, including designing and delivering production-grade applications. Hands-on experience with Golang as a programming language, together with experience building distributed systems, APIs or backend services. Solid understanding of software architecture and object-oriented design, including REST APIs and modern integration patterns. Experience with modern development practices, particularly CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews.
  
  
A collaborative and curious mindset — you enjoy learning from others, sharing knowledge and remaining open to new ideas, technologies and perspectives. You see change as an opportunity to improve products, processes and team effectiveness. Nice to have: Some experience with the .NET ecosystem. Why ASSA ABLOY You’ll join a global organisation where you can work on technology with a real-world purpose, while having the trust and freedom to shape how you contribute.
  
  
You’ll be part of a small team where collaboration is close, ideas are welcome and continuous improvement is part of everyday work. Meaningful mission — Build software that helps connect secure access solutions used in real-world environments around the world. Innovation & scale — Develop your expertise across distributed systems, backend services, integrations and modern software engineering within a global technology organisation. Autonomy & trust — Work in a self-organised team where you’re encouraged to take ownership, explore solutions and influence technical decisions.
  
  
Growth & development — Learn from experienced colleagues, contribute across the technology stack and continuously develop your technical and problem-solving skills. Work–life balance — Work from Stockholm in a hybrid setup, within a Scandinavian culture built around collaboration, trust and sustainable ways of working. Ready to build the connections behind secure access? Apply today and join the team in shaping the backend and integrations behind the next generation of Electronic Access Control.
  
  
We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. Just set up your profile and apply here. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at lea.rein@assaabloy.com Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed.
  
  
Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain industrial applications and services using C#/.NET, Angular, MSSQL, Redis, NATS, and related technologies.
* Own solutions end-to-end, from requirement gathering and architecture through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and troubleshooting while remaining responsible for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of the solution.
* Develop backend services, APIs, and machine-data integrations using technologies such as MQTT, NATS, OPC-UA, and Kepware.
* Design and optimize databases, queries, stored procedures, caching strategies, and production data flows.
* Build real-time dashboards, reporting, and monitoring solutions for production KPIs and operational data.
* Design reliable systems that handle production realities such as high data volumes, concurrency, connectivity issues, duplicate messages, and out-of-order events.
* Troubleshoot issues across frontend, backend, database, messaging, infrastructure, and machine integration layers.
* Work directly with operators, engineers, and production teams to understand requirements, validate solutions, and improve existing systems.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, CI/CD, automated testing, and production diagnostics.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development and operational processes using software and AI.
* Travel abroad when required for business needs, including project implementation, technical support, collaboration.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably involving production systems, manufacturing, MES, industrial automation, or machine integration.
* Strong C#/.NET skills, including ASP.NET Core, APIs, asynchronous programming, and background services.
* Strong Angular and TypeScript development skills.
* Strong MSSQL knowledge, including database design, indexing, query optimization, and stored procedures.
* Understanding of distributed systems, messaging, caching, concurrency, and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with technologies such as NATS, MQTT, OPC-UA, Kepware, or similar industrial integration platforms.
* Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools.
* Ability to review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and architectural fit.
* Understanding of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, logging, and production troubleshooting.
* Strong problem-solving skills across software, database, integration, and manufacturing environments.
* Ability to communicate effectively with software teams, controls engineers, process engineers, operators, and business stakeholders.

* This is an **on-site position** at our Izmir Plant in the **Aegean Free Zone (ESBAS), Izmir, Türkiye**. **Remote or hybrid working is not available.**

***Come join our global, inclusive & diverse team***

Our purpose is to improve the quality of life of everyone we touch through our innovative motion systems. We are a truly global team bound together by our shared values. Our culture is built on the diversity, knowledge, skills, creativity, and talents that each employee brings to the company. Our people are our company’s most valuable asset. We are committed to providing an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace where employees of different backgrounds feel valued and respected, regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity or religious background. We are committed to inspiring our employees to grow, act with ownership and find fulfilment and meaning in the work they do.

jobs.title: Senior Game Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
MERKUR Excellence was founded in 2018 as part of the MERKUR GROUP and specializes in game design and development, with a particular focus on casino games.

We’re looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Game Developer (m/f/d) to join our team in developing high-quality slot machine games for casino platforms. In this role, you will combine strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset to implement engaging gameplay features and maintain robust, high-performance code. If you have extensive experience with Unity and C#, enjoy working in an Agile environment, and thrive in cross-functional teams – this could be the perfect fit for you.

**Your responsibilities**

* As a Senior Game Developer (m/f/d) you will develop and maintain slot machine games for casino platforms using Unity.
* You'll implement gameplay logic and features in close collaboration with Producers, Game Mathematicians, and Artists within an Agile (Scrum) environment.
* Moreover, you will ensure high code quality, performance, and maintainability across the entire development process.
* In addition, you'll contribute to designing clean software architecture and scalable systems while following best practices in game development.

**Your profile**

* Advanced experience with Game Engines (Godot, Unity)
* Advanced knowledge of C# and strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* Experience developing casino games, especially slot machines
* Fluent in English, German is nice to have
* Ability to work independently while being a strong team player

**Your advantages**

* **General conditions:** Flexible working time models, hybrid work model, a minimum salary of EUR 76,216 gross/year
* **Advanced training & career:** High degree of personal responsibility, diverse development opportunities throughout the entire group of companies
* **Team & Community:** Open door attitude, friendly corporate culture, staff events, departmental events
* **Exclusive offers:** Local offers and a great office location
